videos.title: How to Build an AI Document Chatbot in 10 Minutes
videos.description: This video demonstrates building an AI document chatbot using Flowise, an open-source visual tool. It covers leveraging LangchainJS, Node.js, and Docker to create customized large language model applications.

videos.title: Flowise: No Code ChatBot Building Platform: LangChain
videos.description: This video introduces Flowise, a no-code chatbot platform built on LangChain. It demonstrates how to use its drag-and-drop UI, leveraging react-flow technology, for experimental prototyping of chatbot flows with an integrated chat box.

videos.title: Flowise AI Tutorial #1: Build AI Apps With No Code
videos.description: This video demonstrates building AI applications and chatbots without code using Flowise. It covers local installation methods for Flowise and provides a comprehensive tour of its user interface and core functionalities like the dashboard, marketplace, and credentials.

videos.title: Flowise AI Tutorial #1 - Introduction & Setup
videos.description: This video introduces Flowise, an open-source tool for building LangChain AI applications via a user interface. It covers local setup, running Flowise, UI overview, marketplace, API key management for OpenAI, and testing chat flows.

videos.title: Flowise AI Tutorial #2 - Creating ChatFlows (LLM Chains, Chat Models & Agents)
videos.description: This video demonstrates creating Flowise AI chatflows. It covers building LLM, conversational, and agent chains, integrating chat models, handling user input, formatting prompts, and using tools like the SERP API.

videos.title: Flowise Tutorial: Output Parsers & IfElse for Structured AI Flows
videos.description: This video explores Output Parsers in Flowise, including Structured Output and List Parsers, to manage AI model outputs. It also demonstrates using the IfElse node to conditionally invoke chains, detailing its function logic within AI workflows.

videos.title: Flowise AI Tutorial #2: Build Your First Chatflow with LLM Chains
videos.description: This tutorial demonstrates building a basic chatflow in FlowiseAI. It covers integrating an OpenAI Large Language Model and constructing an LLM Chain with a prompt template to create an interactive AI application.

videos.title: Flowise AI Agents Tutorial: Build an Assistant That Uses Tools (No Code)

videos.title: Flowise AI Tutorial #11- Custom Tools, OpenAI Functions and Webhooks
videos.description: This tutorial covers implementing custom tools in Flowise for chatbot functionality, focusing on integrating OpenAI functions and webhooks. It explains code for custom tools and demonstrates their application, including using Make.com with webhooks for data interaction.

videos.title: Flowise AI Tutorial #7 - Adding Chatbots to Websites using Embed API
videos.description: This video demonstrates integrating a Flowise chatbot into a website using its Embed API. It covers setting up Pinecone, creating Flowise chatflows for data ingestion and QA, and embedding the chatbot into a sample project, including styling with TailwindCSS.

videos.title: Flowise AI Tutorial #4 - Vector Store Injest & Query (incl. Pinecone)
videos.description: This video demonstrates building a document chatbot using Flowise AI, LangChain, and Pinecone. It covers creating two chatflows: one for ingesting documents into a Pinecone vector store and another for querying the stored data to answer questions.

videos.title: Flowise AI: Create LLM Apps with NO Code - FREE Opensource LangChain Apps
videos.description: This video introduces Flowise, an open-source tool built on LangChain.js. It demonstrates how its GUI enables no-code development of LLM applications, including creating a PDF chatbot. Topics cover installation, UI overview, and features for building generative AI apps.

videos.title: FlowiseAI Tutorial #5: Build a Chatbot with Long-Term Memory
videos.description: This video details building FlowiseAI chatbots with long-term memory. It covers Conversation Chains, Buffer Memory, Upstash Redis Memory for persistent history, Chat Prompt Templates, and Moderation nodes, integrating OpenAI and LangChain concepts.
